definitions.explanation: Describes something done perfectly or matching exactly as intended, with no problems or mistakes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ばっちり⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{化粧|けしょう}→化粧：02699_keshou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ばっちり⟦{決|き}まっている→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦プレゼン→プレゼン：05505_purezen⟧、ばっちり⟦うまくいった→上手くいく：21787_umakuiku⟧。

notes:
USAGE:
ばっちり is an informal, expressive word conveying confidence that something is exactly right or will work out perfectly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ばっちり⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧: to look perfect, to be decided perfectly
- ⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ばっちり: preparations are perfect
- ばっちりOK: totally okay
- ばっちり⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: to fit perfectly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{完璧|かんぺき}→完璧：09505_kanpeki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: perfectly (more formal)
- ⟦きっちり→きっちり：10310_kicchiri⟧: precisely, exactly
- ⟦ぴったり→ぴったり：02362_pittari⟧: exactly fitting
